nodes.name: System Architecture
nodes.summary: Defines the full tech stack (React 19 + FastAPI async + SQLAlchemy 2.0 + SQLite/PostgreSQL) and layered architecture pattern with distinct responsibilities for Routes, Services, Repositories, Middleware, and Auth. Includes ASCII diagram of the three-tier SPA → FastAPI → Database stack and JWT-based auth with token revocation.

nodes.name: Database Schema
nodes.summary: Documents all 56 database tables (769+ columns, 143 foreign keys) organized into 11 domains: Auth/RBAC, CRM, Product Catalog, Equipment, Quotations, Rental Contracts, Movements, Maintenance, Inventory, Billing, and Audit. Includes ER overview diagram and per-domain table breakdown with column counts and purpose.

nodes.name: API Inventory
nodes.summary: Complete inventory of 218 REST endpoints across 17 route modules under /api/v1/*. Includes per-module HTTP verb counts and state machine workflow diagrams for the Quotation, Rental Contract, Asset Movement, Work Order, and Billing workflows.

nodes.name: Frontend Modules
nodes.summary: Catalogs the React/TypeScript frontend: 48 lazy-loaded pages across 16 domains, 76 components (layout, UI, domain, module), 17 Axios API clients, 4 Zustand stores, and a CSS architecture based on design tokens. Covers routing, state management, and component hierarchy.

nodes.name: RBAC Model
nodes.summary: Defines the role-based access control system with 4 roles (super_admin, manager, sales, support) and 32 named permissions. Covers the permission matrix per role, compile-time PermissionName enum, require_permission() dependency factory, startup role seeding, and gaps where maintenance/inventory/movement modules lack dedicated permissions.

nodes.name: Project Structure
nodes.summary: Full annotated directory tree of the CRM monorepo: Docker Compose / Nginx config at root, backend Python app under backend/app/ (routes, services, repositories, models, schemas, core), and frontend src/ (pages, components, modules, stores, api clients, styles). Includes file count summary (94 Python files, ~140 TS/TSX files, 56 DB tables).

nodes.name: Dependency Graph
nodes.summary: Maps the backend dependency chain (Routes → Schemas/Services → Repositories → Models → Database Session → Config) and cross-service call graph (rental_workflow_service orchestrates billing, forklift status, and movement services). Also covers the frontend component hierarchy and all Python (requirements.txt) and npm package dependencies.

nodes.name: Business Workflows
nodes.summary: Detailed ASCII flow diagrams for 7 core operational workflows: Sales Pipeline (Lead → Quotation → Rental Contract), Equipment Lifecycle (in_stock / rented / in_service / sold / decommissioned), Rental Operations (delivery, billing cycles, extensions, returns, damage reports), Billing Cycle (invoice → payment → revenue recognition), Maintenance Operations (PM plan → schedule → work order → inventory consumption), Inventory Management (PO → receive → issue/transfer/consume), and Product Catalog Excel import.

nodes.name: Gap Analysis
nodes.summary: Rates 18 modules by completion (87% overall), identifies 5 missing modules (Settings, Notifications, Automotive Service, Technician Management, Customer Portal), 6 incomplete modules, 7 architecture issues (no test suite, no rate limiting, SQLite/PostgreSQL drift), 8 database schema gaps, 5 API gaps, and 7 frontend gaps. Provides a prioritized 10-item refactoring backlog.
